headline: Just Eat Pauses Rollout of AI Food Imagery Following Online Backlash
summary: Just Eat apologized and halted the deployment of its artificial intelligence image generator after public ridicule over inaccurate food photographs on its food delivery platform.
why: Just Eat Takeaway is one of Europe's largest food delivery operators, where app conversion and customer satisfaction are sensitive to visual accuracy and platform trust.

impacts.name: Just Eat Takeaway.com N.V.
impacts.why: Pausing the tool prevents further customer dissatisfaction but delays anticipated cost efficiencies from automated imagery.
